title: UNI approval evidence bundle
description: The bundle that MUST accompany any mutating MCP call (D-B1) and every uni_propose_change (C-C1). Every approval decision becomes reproducible from these shas alone: the human sees the SAME bytes the agent saw. Attached to production/mcp/server.py:235-260 approvals.require(summary=...).

git_head_sha.description: The SHA of the code that produced this bundle. If null the bundle is refused.

colony_gate_stdout_sha.description: sha256 of the current viewer/verify_colony.cjs stdout against COLONY_HOST. Required for any mutation that could affect the colony (start_broadcast, panic, uni_propose_change touching lib/sp/**).

heartbeat_tail_ndjson_sha.description: sha256 of the tail (last 100 rows) of /var/lib/uni/broadcast/audit/heartbeat.ndjson. Proves the requester saw a fresh mesh state.

verify_p1_stdout_sha.description: sha256 of the current production/verify_p1_v2.sh output. Required for any mutation touching the relay lane (node2).

fleet_status_sha.description: sha256 of the last row of /var/lib/uni/status/fleet_status.ndjson (D-C1). Required for cross-box mutations.

lab_team_review_receipt_path.description: Repo-relative path to a docs/receipts/lab_team_review_<sha>.md. REQUIRED for any FE-touching change or new MCP verb (C-C1); mechanically enforced (non-empty) for uni_propose_change via the `uni_propose_change` variant below. Empty for pure-OS mutations on other mutating tools.

typed_spec_path.description: Repo-relative path to the typed spec artifact (C-C1). REQUIRED for uni_propose_change; mechanically enforced via the `uni_propose_change` variant below.

paired_red_launcher_path.description: Repo-relative path to the runs/*.exs RED launcher (C-C1). REQUIRED for uni_propose_change; mechanically enforced via the `uni_propose_change` variant below.

uni_propose_change.description: Tool-specific variant of this schema for `uni_propose_change` (C-C1) only, referenced by production/mcp/SPEC_uni_propose_change.md refusal check #5 as `evidence_bundle.schema.json#/$defs/uni_propose_change`. The base schema above (D-B1) stays generic -- it MUST accompany ANY mutating MCP call and leaves lab_team_review_receipt_path / typed_spec_path / paired_red_launcher_path optional so pure-OS mutations on other tools are not forced to carry them. This variant is strictly additive on top of the base (same $id, same additionalProperties:false) and layers the three C-C1 fields as REQUIRED non-empty strings, which is what makes refusal check #5 mechanically checkable by schema validation alone rather than by prose. RESOLUTION NOTE (implementation-critical): this variant is self-referential (`allOf` includes `{"$ref": "#"}`) and MUST be validated against the enclosing document, keeping this schema's own `$id` as the base URI (e.g. resolve `evidence_bundle.schema.json#/$defs/uni_propose_change` through a registry/resolver rooted at the parent document). Extracting `$defs.uni_propose_change` into a standalone dict and validating an instance against it in isolation makes `"$ref": "#"` resolve back to that same standalone dict, which recurses to RecursionError (reproduced against jsonschema 4.23.0, Draft 2020-12).
